memories.title: Project indent convention
memories.content: This repository always uses two-space indent. Never insert tabs in TypeScript or JavaScript files.

memories.title: Do not edit generated artifacts
memories.content: Files under generated/ are produced by a build step. Always change the source of truth in src/ instead of generated/.

memories.title: Config lives in src/deep/nested/config.ts
memories.content: The runtime feature flag is defined in src/deep/nested/config.ts. Read that file first instead of searching the whole tree.

memories.title: Handlers are named exports
memories.content: HTTP handlers live in src/handlers and must be named exports, never default exports.

memories.title: Use Node crypto for checksums
memories.content: Do not spawn python for checksums. Use node:crypto createHash('sha256') in src/checksum.mjs.

memories.title: Active timeout is in policy/current.md
memories.content: The authoritative timeout is 45 seconds in policy/current.md. Ignore stale notes about 10 seconds.

experiences.title: Python checksum hangs
experiences.summary: Spawning python for hashing wasted a round and timed out.
